headline: Cultural economy grows, but does not recover its workforce
summary: Mexico's cultural GDP rose 1.7% in 2025, according to INEGI data. Real output remains below 2019 levels, and the sector has 163,622 fewer jobs than before the pandemic.
why: INEGI is Mexico's national statistics agency, and its national accounts data guide assessments of sector growth. Cultural industries are part of the broader services economy.
original_headline: Economía cultural crece, pero no recupera su fuerza laboral
